cards.p: A new client wants to book a [breed]. Reply: price range [range], how long it takes, two open slots.
Write 8 intake questions for a new dog: age, vaccines on file, health notes, behavior, last groom, emergency contact.
Write a text booking [pet]'s next groom in [X] weeks before they leave. Offer [day 1] or [day 2].
Write a post saying my holiday slots open [date] and fill fast. How to book [link], last day [date].
Explain kindly to [name] why their matted [breed] needs a short shave today, and how to avoid mats next time.
A client says their dog is nervous at grooming. Reply with how I handle it: [my approach]. Warm, short.
Text [name] that [pet] is ready for pick up. Add one sweet line about the groom and my hours [hours].
A client says [pet]'s cut is not what they wanted: [paste]. Reply calmly, offer a free fix within [days].
Turn my messy notes into a clean cut card for [pet]: blade, length, face style, likes, dislikes: [paste].
Plan my grooming day from these bookings: [paste]. Order by size and drying time, add two breaks.
I found [lump, cut, fleas] on [pet] today. Write a calm note to the owner, no diagnosis, suggest their vet.
Write my drop off and pick up rules in plain words: times, late fee [fee], what if a dog bites.
Write a text asking [name] for a Google review today, while [pet] still looks fresh. Short, link [link].
Reply to this 5 star review in my voice: [paste]. Mention [pet] by name. Under 30 words.
Reply to this review saying I charged too much: [paste]. Calm, explain my size and matting fees, invite a call.
Here are my last 20 reviews: [paste]. What do people love and what do they complain about? Top 3 each.
Write 3 captions for this before and after of a [breed]: [describe]. Fun, short, end with how to book.
Write a breed of the week post on grooming a [breed]: how often, coat type, one home brushing tip.
Write a meet the groomer post from these facts: [paste]. Warm, 60 words, end with one fun fact.
Give me 10 post ideas for my grooming page that need no new photos. One line each.
[Name] missed their [time] groom. Write a kind text with my no show fee [fee] and a rebook link [link].
Write a short matting and extra time fee policy: [fee] per [minutes], always told before I start.
Sort my supply receipts into shampoo, blades, tools, treats, other: [paste]. Total each, flag repeat buys.
Design a puppy intro package from my prices [paste]: 3 short visits, what each includes, one price.
